declarations.name: OcelleBrandMark

members.name: ground
members.description:
The ground the mark sits on: `chrome` for the dark chrome grounds (`color-chrome`, `color-chrome-hover`); absent or
any other value for the main grounds. Reflected.

members.name: tone
members.description:
`mono` paints ring and spot in `currentColor`, the colour of the surrounding text, and wins over `ground`; absent
or any other value paints the variant of `ground`. Reflected.

members.name: label
members.description:
The accessible name of the mark, trimmed; empty or whitespace-only counts as none, and without one the mark is
hidden from the accessibility tree. Not reflected.

declarations.name: OcelleCopyField

members.name: copyLabel
members.description: The Copy control's accessible name, trimmed; empty or whitespace-only gives the default. Not reflected.

members.name: value
members.description:
The text shown and requested, as written. A change after first render clears `status`. With an empty value the
Copy control is disabled and emits nothing. Not reflected.

members.name: status
members.description:
The host's outcome text, shown as the content of the field's polite live region; blank shows nothing. The field
clears it (the property then reads `""`) when a request starts and when `value` changes after first render.
Setting the text the region already holds changes nothing. Not reflected: a `status` attribute stays as written.

events.name: ocelle-copy-field-request
events.description: The user activated the Copy control (a click, Enter or Space): `text` is `value` at the activation. Dispatched after the next rendering update, outside the activation's task, once the cleared `status` has reached the accessibility tree; not cancelable. The field never writes the clipboard: the host does, and reports the outcome in `status`.

declarations.description:
A command or identifier with a flush Copy control that asks the host to copy it; the host reports the outcome in
`status`, which the field shows in a polite live region.

cssParts.name: value
cssParts.description: The text, on the inset well. Public surface: it stays when the Copy control becomes `ocelle-button`.

cssParts.name: copy-control
cssParts.description: The Copy control. It guarantees its box (its position, its size and the rules a host sets on it), its accessible name and the events its activation leads to, not which element carries it (a native button today, `ocelle-button` later).

attributes.name: value
attributes.description:
The text shown and requested, as written. A change after first render clears `status`. With an empty value the
Copy control is disabled and emits nothing. Not reflected.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description:
The host's outcome text, shown as the content of the field's polite live region; blank shows nothing. The field
clears it (the property then reads `""`) when a request starts and when `value` changes after first render.
Setting the text the region already holds changes nothing. Not reflected: a `status` attribute stays as written.

attributes.name: copy-label
attributes.description: The Copy control's accessible name, trimmed; empty or whitespace-only gives the default. Not reflected.

declarations.name: OcelleLink

members.name: href
members.description:
The link's target, as written: the anchor carries it while it resolves to an allowed protocol, and the event's
`detail.href` reports it. Without it the link only emits its event. Reflected.

members.name: label
members.description:
The link's accessible name instead of its text, trimmed; blank counts as none. It must contain the visible text.
A host `aria-label` does not name the link. Not reflected.

events.name: ocelle-link-activate
events.description: The user activated the link with Enter or a primary-button click (no modifier, or Alt alone): `href` is the `href` attribute as written, not validated, or `null` without one. Cancelable: a cancelled event stops the link's own navigation. A modified activation (Ctrl, Meta or Shift held, or a middle click) emits nothing.

declarations.description:
A link in running text that tells the host it was activated, and navigates to an allowed `href` unless the host
cancels.

cssParts.name: anchor
cssParts.description: The link's anchor: the native `<a>` that is focused and activated.

attributes.name: href
attributes.description:
The link's target, as written: the anchor carries it while it resolves to an allowed protocol, and the event's
`detail.href` reports it. Without it the link only emits its event. Reflected.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description:
The link's accessible name instead of its text, trimmed; blank counts as none. It must contain the visible text.
A host `aria-label` does not name the link. Not reflected.

declarations.name: OcelleListbox

members.name: label
members.description:
The listbox's accessible name, trimmed; empty or whitespace-only counts as none, and a host `aria-label` decides
over it. Not reflected.

members.name: value
members.description:
The selected option's value, `""` when none. Setting it selects the first enabled option with the value; `""` or a
value no enabled option has clears the selection, and a non-empty such value is remembered until an option with it
appears or is enabled. A set never emits an event; setting the current value changes nothing. Not reflected.

events.name: ocelle-listbox-change
events.description: The user selected another option (Enter, Space or a click); `value` already reads it.

events.name: ocelle-listbox-activate
events.description: The user confirmed an option: Enter on the selected enabled option, or a double-click on an enabled option. Not cancelable.

declarations.description: A single-select listbox of `ocelle-option` children, one tab stop, keyboard and pointer selection.

cssParts.name: list
cssParts.description: The scroll container of the options; a host limits the listbox's height with `max-block-size` on the listbox.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description:
The listbox's accessible name, trimmed; empty or whitespace-only counts as none, and a host `aria-label` decides
over it. Not reflected.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description:
The selected option's value, `""` when none. Setting it selects the first enabled option with the value; `""` or a
value no enabled option has clears the selection, and a non-empty such value is remembered until an option with it
appears or is enabled. A set never emits an event; setting the current value changes nothing. Not reflected.

slots.name: icon
slots.description: A leading icon, by the slot convention; it adds nothing to the option's name.

declarations.name: OcelleOption

members.name: disabled
members.description:
Whether the option is disabled: it cannot be selected, the keys and the tab stop skip it, and it stays focusable,
so a focused option that becomes disabled keeps focus. Reflected.

members.name: value
members.description:
The option's value, reported by the listbox's `value` and events: the `value` attribute as written (not trimmed),
or, when it is missing or blank, the option's index among its parent's options, as a string, which is not written
to the attribute. Reflected.
members.default: the option's index, as a string

declarations.description: An option of an `ocelle-listbox`: its content is its label, with an optional leading icon.

declarations.name: OcelleSegmentedChoice

members.name: label
members.description:
The toolbar's accessible name, trimmed; empty or whitespace-only counts as none, and a host `aria-label` decides
over it. Not reflected.

members.name: joined
members.description:
The joined variant: the segments touch with one shared line between neighbours and between rows, and only each
row's first and last segments have rounded outer corners, recomputed by the element when it wraps. Reflected.

members.name: value
members.description:
The pressed segment's value; `""` only while no segment is enabled. Setting it presses the first enabled segment
with the value; `""` or a value no enabled segment has keeps the press, and a non-empty such value is remembered
until a segment with it appears or is enabled. A set never emits an event; setting the current value changes
nothing. Not reflected.

events.name: ocelle-segmented-choice-change
events.description: The user pressed another segment (Enter, Space or a click); `value` already reads it.

declarations.description:
A toolbar of `ocelle-segment` toggle buttons, exactly one pressed; one tab stop, keyboard and pointer pressing, and a
joined variant that rounds each row's ends itself.

over it. Not reflected.

attributes.name: joined

row's first and last segments have rounded outer corners, recomputed by the element when it wraps. Reflected.

attributes.name: value
